item.title: [+1] US assures India of tariffs below those on rival exporters as trade talks target a first-phase deal
item.description:
Reports say Washington promised India a tariff edge over peers; both sides aim to conclude a first phase by next month's G20 summit. Easing, despite this week's US duties on Indian solar panels.

Pharma & healthcare: mild tailwind (+1) — US market access

Why it matters: A relative tariff advantage would help labour-intensive exporters win US orders; details and timing remain unconfirmed.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
